RRB Paramedical Staff CEN 03/2025 DV Call Letter 2026

Post Date: June 17, 2026

10:40 am

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB), has released the DV Call Letter on the official website for the recruitment of Paramedical Staff Posts. The exam was conducted from 11, 12 & 13 March 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 20 September 2025. Candidates Can Also Check their DV Call Letter using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link will be provided below. (Advt No : 03/2025)
